author: Parsifal-2045
body:
This PR updates the IB and PR timing tests to take advantage of the improvements to the patatrack scripts (https://github.com/cms-patatrack/patatrack-scripts/pull/61) . In order to facilitate testing I've opened an equivalent PR to cms-externals/patatrack-scripts: https://github.com/cms-externals/patatrack-scripts/pull/2 and temporarily told the testing scripts to fetch the patatrack-scripts form cms-externals (commit to be dropped once the setup is validated).
This PR should be tested together with https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51904 and merged together with that PR and the one to cms-patatrack/patatrack-scripts
title: Introduce support for the reworked patatrack-scripts
